profile.name: Talha Shaharyar
profile.headline: From project delivery to intelligent construction systems.
profile.intro: I work across construction delivery, estimating, BIM, AI-enabled project workflows, and research into project-aware automation.

chapters.title: Learn the work: estimating, contracts and construction delivery
chapters.body: Built a foundation in takeoff, cost estimating, scheduling, BIM, construction contracts and field-oriented project controls.

chapters.title: Deliver projects: U.S. project engineering and controls
chapters.body: Supported a $12.4M Caltrans rest-area project across planning, RFIs, submittals, change orders, procurement, permitting, inspections and cost control.

chapters.title: Connect project knowledge with intelligent systems
chapters.body: Now working with AI-powered project management while developing research directions around BIM, RAG, project information, robotics and construction automation.

timelineIntro: This detailed timeline brings together selected experience, projects, research directions, education and certifications.

timeline.title: Product Solutions Engineer
timeline.description: Client-facing work on an AI-powered project-management platform: workflow discovery, requirements, solution design, product feedback, R&D support and construction use cases.

timeline.title: $12.4M Caltrans Rest Area Project
timeline.description: Planning, CPM schedule updates, subcontractor coordination, RFIs, submittals, change orders, permitting, inspections, procurement, documentation and cost control.

timeline.title: Quantity Takeoff & Cost Estimating
timeline.description: Prepared takeoffs, detailed estimates, bid packages and scope interpretation using PlanSwift and Bluebeam across architectural and structural drawings.

timeline.title: Bachelor of Civil Engineering
timeline.description: Civil engineering degree with work in BIM, scheduling, structural design, tendering, construction management and contract administration.

works.title: Project Knowledge for Automation
works.description: Connecting drawings, specifications, BIM, schedules, RFIs, submittals, reports and field data to automated construction systems.

works.title: BIM-to-Cloud Data Pipeline
works.description: A Revit/C# concept for linking model information to cloud systems and downstream workflows.

works.title: AI-Assisted Project Information
works.description: RAG and document-intelligence ideas for RFIs, submittals, estimating, schedules and decision support.

research.statement: Automated systems need access to project knowledge, not just perception and task logic.
research.body: The next generation of construction automation should connect perception and planning with the information that actually governs a project: drawings, specifications, BIM, scope, sequence, schedule, safety constraints, RFIs, submittals, daily reports and project history.

contact.heading: Build, research, collaborate.
contact.body: Open to construction technology, project engineering, digital construction and research collaborations.
